subject: Energy
title: Laser-Driven Fusion
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Laser-Driven Fusion.

hook.text: Inertial confinement uses lasers to crush a fuel pellet until atoms fuse—originally developed for weapons research.

buildup.text: The NIF's 192 lasers deliver 2 MJ to a pellet the size of a peppercorn—compressing it to incredible density.

discovery.text: In December 2022, NIF achieved ignition—the fusion output exceeded the laser energy input for the first time.

twist.text: But the total facility used 300 MJ of electricity to power those 2 MJ lasers—actual energy gain is far off.

climax.text: Laser fusion needs firing hundreds of times per second for power—current lasers can fire about once per day.

punchline.text: One shot proved it works—now do it a million times a day.

quiz.question: What milestone did NIF achieve in December 2022?
